subject: Re: Packaging & SLA options for tracing, retention, and dashboards
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: Denise Hunter <denise.hunter@skywardhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Packaging & SLA options for tracing, retention, and dashboards

Hi Denise — great to meet earlier. As promised, attached is a concise packaging proposal for the observability add-ons you asked about: trace retention, distributed tracing ingest, and the advanced dashboard suite. High-level options below (monthly list):

1) Core Tracing (ingest-based)
   - 50k traces/day baseline: $2,400
   - 150k traces/day baseline: $6,500
   - Additional traces billed per 1k at $4.00

2) Extended Retention (per-hosted-model key)
   - 30 day (default): included
   - 90 day: +$1,500
   - 365 day: +$6,200
   - Per-GB cold storage option: $0.07/GB/month (for very large archives)

3) Advanced Dashboards & Alerts (seat + metrics hybrid)
   - Base seat fee: $35/seat/month (up to 10 seats)
   - Metrics overage: $0.02/metric-point/month beyond 10k points
   - Premium widgets (cross-tenant correlation, A/B latency baselines): add-on $1,200/mo

Concession paths we can consider if you commit to a 12-month reserved add-on spend:
   - 12-month commit: 12% credit applied to add-on invoice (usage credits)
   - 24-month commit: 18% credit + first full month free of Advanced Dashboards

I've attached the v2 proposal (line-item pricing and SLA retention table) and a simple example CSV that shows how credits would amortize across months. If you prefer seat-only billing for dashboards instead of a hybrid metric model, we can map that out — usually the tradeoff is predictability (seat) vs cost-sensitivity (metric-based).

Next steps: tell me which retention tier and dashboard billing model you prefer and I can send a redline-ready proposal. Happy to jump on a 30-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rohan_mehta@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments: Skyward_Proposal_v2.pdf; SLA_Retention_Table.xlsx; Commit_Credit_Example.csv
From: Denise Hunter <denise.hunter@skywardhealth.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T11:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Packaging & SLA options for tracing, retention, and dashboards

Rohan — thanks for the detailed breakdown. A few questions / asks from procurement and engineering:

- Can you move dashboards to a pure seat model? We want predictable line items; engineering will not tolerate per-metric surprises.
- We need 365-day trace retention for our clinical audit requirements, but the price you quoted is above our internal threshold. Is there room to bring the 365-day add-on down to ~$4,500/mo if we buy a 12-month commit?
- We also need two things in the contract: (1) explicit export access to cold archives for audits, and (2) an ability to pull the last 12 months of traces within 72 hours if required.

Also — can you provide a one-time onboarding credit to offset our first-month spike (we anticipate a migration flush)?

Denise
Sr. Procurement Manager
Skyward Health
denise.hunter@skywardhealth.com
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T13:42:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Packaging & SLA options for tracing, retention, and dashboards — discount ask / contract asks

Marissa / Markus — Denise is pushing for: seat-only dashboards, 365-day retention at ~$4.5k/mo, audit export language, and a one-time onboarding credit. Can we do the following concession play?

Option A (12-month commit):
  - 365-day retention at $4,800/mo (we absorb $1,400/mo vs list)
  - Seat-only dashboards at $40/seat (min 8 seats)
  - One-time onboarding credit: $6,000 (applied as usage credits over first 3 invoices)
  - Legal to add export SLA: 72-hour delivery for archived trace exports (subject to egress fees)

Option B (24-month commit):
  - 365-day retention at $4,200/mo
  - Seat-only dashboards at $35/seat (min 8 seats)
  - Onboarding credit: $12,000 (first invoice credit)

Asks: approval to offer Option A without exec sign-off, Option B requires Marissa/RevOps approval (discount > 15%). Also need to coordinate Legal on the export/egress clause and Finance for committed invoice credit accounting.

I recommend Option A as our counter if we want to keep handoff timeline short.

Thanks,
Rohan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T15:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Packaging & SLA options for tracing, retention, and dashboards — discount ask / contract asks

Rohan — Option A is fine to offer with the following tie-breakers:

  - Keep the $6k onboarding credit but split it over the first two invoices (helps cash).
  - Add a firm egress pricing line: $0.09/GB for export of archived traces; Legal will not accept an open 'egress fees TBD'.
  - Limit the 72-hour export SLA to a maximum of 1TB per export request; larger exports require a scheduled delivery up to 7 days.
  - Mark the discount as conditional on no more than a 25% month-over-month ingestion increase during the first 3 months; if usage spikes beyond that, we reserve the right to renegotiate pricing or revert to metric billing.

I'll loop in Legal and Finance after you confirm the customer accepts Option A. This keeps us within the margin band and avoids a formal pricing escalation.

Marissa Cole
Head of Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: Denise Hunter <denise.hunter@skywardhealth.com>, procurement@skywardhealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Updated proposal — 12-month commit Option A (seat dashboards + 365d retention)

Denise — thanks for the clarity. We can move forward with Option A as a counter-offer. Changes vs the original proposal: 

  - 365-day trace retention: $4,800/mo (12-month commit)
  - Dashboards: seat-only at $40/seat/month (minimum 8 seats)
  - Onboarding credit: $6,000 applied across first two invoices as usage credits
  - Export SLA: 72 hours for up to 1TB; exports charged at $0.09/GB for archived data beyond included thresholds
  - Usage spike protection: discount tied to <25% MoM ingestion increase in months 1–3; above that, we will engage to adjust billing model

I've attached an updated PDF and a DocuSign link to sign the addendum (link below). If this looks good, I can get Legal to add the explicit export clause and send a final redline.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/link/abcdef123456
Proposal: Skyward_Proposal_v2.pdf

If you'd like a short call to walk procurement/legal through the export SLA and the credit amortization, I'm available today 2–4pm PT.

Best,
Rohan
From: Denise Hunter <denise.hunter@skywardhealth.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@skywardhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-06T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Updated proposal — 12-month commit Option A (seat dashboards + 365d retention)

Rohan — appreciate the fast turnaround. I will present Option A to legal and procurement tomorrow. Two small asks before we sign: please confirm the export egress cap is not applied in the first 30 days of activation (migration window), and can you extend the DocuSign link expiration by one week?

If we get that, I expect procurement to approve and sign the addendum next week.

Denise

-- End of thread --
